metadata.dcterms:title: Θ -Categories and Tannakian duality
metadata.dcterms:creator: Joost NUITEN, Bertrand TOEN
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We introduce a notion of Θ-categories, which is a refinement of the notion of symmetric monoidal ∞-categories. We use this notion to prove a Tannakian duality statement, relating Θ-categories with fpqc- stacks by means of a certain stack of fiber functors in the context of Θ-categories. This provides, over a base ring of arbitrary characteris- tic, a strong link between Tannakian Θ-categories and the schematic homotopy types of [Toe06].
